claims: The 2026 Men's Final Four takes place on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
The 2026 Men's Final Four games are held in Indianapolis, Indiana, at Lucas Oil Stadium.
The National Championship game will take place on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Game 1 of the 2026 Final Four is #2 UConn vs. #3 Illinois at 6:09 p.m. ET on TBS.
Game 2 of the 2026 Final Four is #1 Arizona vs. #1 Michigan at approx. 8:49 p.m. ET on TBS.
Games of the 2026 Men's Final Four will be broadcast on TBS, TNT, and truTV.
TBS, TNT, and truTV are the main broadcast partners for the men's tournament.
Max offers coverage of TBS, TNT, and truTV games.
Sling TV offers a "Sling Orange" package.
Sling TV offers a "Sling Day Pass".
DirecTV provides access to all necessary channels.
Hulu + Live TV includes TBS, TNT, and TruTV.
March Madness Live generally requires a TV provider login for full access.
